content.value_statement: Avalonia teams need consistent ViewModel, wizard, and navigation patterns. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to apply Zafiro and ReactiveUI conventions.
actual_capabilities: Creates ReactiveUI ViewModel patterns using ReactiveObject, reactive properties, and derived state.
Guides IEnhancedCommand setup with progress, labels, error handling, and disposable command subscriptions.
Designs SlimWizard flows with validation gates, custom next commands, completion steps, and navigator integration.
Explains section-based navigation using INavigator, Section attributes, and automatic registration.
Shows ViewModel-to-View mapping through DataTypeViewLocator and CompositionRoot dependency registration.
limitations: Does not verify installed Zafiro, Avalonia, or ReactiveUI package versions.
Does not run builds, tests, or UI automation for generated code.
Assumes the project already follows Avalonia MVVM architecture.
Does not cover advanced platform-specific controls or custom rendering.

use_cases.title: Create a Reactive Screen Model
use_cases.description: Generate a focused ViewModel with reactive properties, command metadata, validation state, and cleanup guidance.

use_cases.title: Standardize Wizard Flows
use_cases.description: Plan multi-step application flows with SlimWizard, step ViewModels, final actions, and predictable navigation rules.

use_cases.title: Wire Application Composition
use_cases.description: Map Views to ViewModels, register services, and organize section discovery in a maintainable composition root.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic ViewModel
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for a single screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Avalonia ViewModel plan for a simple form using ReactiveUI and Zafiro. Include properties, command names, validation state, and cleanup needs.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Command Handling
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate refactor of existing command logic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this ViewModel command design and convert it to a Zafiro IEnhancedCommand approach. Include progress, display text, error handling, and disposal guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Wizard Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a SlimWizard flow for this user journey. Define each step ViewModel, navigation rule, validation gate, final result, and navigator integration.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Application Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a Zafiro composition structure for this Avalonia app. Cover ViewModel registration, View mapping, section discovery, and service lifetime choices.

output_examples.input: A settings screen needs save, reset, validation, and error notifications.
output_examples.output: A ViewModel outline with reactive settings properties, can-save state, enhanced save and reset commands, notification handling, and disposable subscriptions.

output_examples.input: A project creation flow needs account selection, project details, confirmation, and completion.
output_examples.output: A SlimWizard plan with four step ViewModels, validation before navigation, a final commit step, and result handling after navigation.

output_examples.input: An app needs sidebar sections and automatic ViewModel registration.
output_examples.output: A composition plan covering Section attributes, service registration, navigator usage, View mapping, and shell ViewModel section switching.

best_practices: Use reactive derived state for command availability instead of manual flag updates.
Dispose subscriptions and command handlers through a shared CompositeDisposable.
Keep ViewModel registration and View mapping centralized in the composition root.
anti_patterns: Do not put navigation and service construction directly inside Views.
Do not create wizard steps without clear validation and completion rules.
Do not leave reactive subscriptions unmanaged across ViewModel lifetimes.

faq.question: What projects is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for Avalonia applications that use Zafiro and ReactiveUI for MVVM, commands, navigation, and wizard flows.

faq.question: Can it generate complete working code?
faq.answer: It can guide code structure and patterns, but you must verify namespaces, package versions, builds, and tests locally.

faq.question: Does it require Zafiro?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance depends on Zafiro concepts such as IEnhancedCommand, SlimWizard, DataTypeViewLocator, and section discovery.

faq.question: Can it help refactor existing ViewModels?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current ViewModel design and ask for ReactiveUI, command, disposal, and error handling improvements.

faq.question: Does it cover dependency injection?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains composition root patterns, service lifetimes, ViewModel registration, and View-to-ViewModel mapping.

faq.question: Is this a security-sensitive skill?
faq.answer: No evidence of external execution or data access was found. It is documentation guidance for Avalonia application structure.
